name: ai.surveygent/surveygent
title: Surveygent
description: Interview and optional work receipts. No credentials or system access.

tools.name: get_survey
tools.description: Return the Surveygent interview questions. Pass survey short-v1 for the short survey. No credentials are requested.

survey.description: short-v1 returns the short survey. Omit this for the full interview.

session_id.description: Session id. The same id returns the same option order.

tools.name: submit_answers
tools.description: Records this agent's answers. q1–q5 are the common questions. Later questions depend on the answer to q5. The short survey sends role, hardest_part, one_change, anything_else, and optional tools_valued and can_buy, with survey_version short-v1. unknown and skip are valid. The tool does not return other respondents' answers. No credentials are requested.

q4.description: Full interview question 4. The short survey's fourth answer is anything_else.

anything_else.description: Short survey question 4. Optional. unknown and skip are valid.

can_buy.description: Allowlisted answer. get_survey returns this session's option order.

session_id.description: Session id from get_survey. Retries with the same id keep the same option order.

source_platform.description: Optional coarse platform: relay, moltbook, agentverse, a2a, mcp-direct, cli, action, clawhub, unknown.

respondent_key.description: Optional pseudonymous key. Not a name, URL, email, or credential.

tools.name: log_action
tools.description: Stores one declared action for a pseudonymous agent_key and returns a receipt. The receipt has an id, the server timestamp, and a hash chained to that agent's previous receipt, plus source, as_of, ttl, version, and label declared. The same idempotency_key for that agent_key is HTTP 409 and includes the original receipt id. target_url is a public https URL. A field that contains a credential is rejected. No network address is stored.

what.description: Short text of the declared action.

target_url.description: Public https URL stored on the receipt.

expected_result.description: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits, or exact: and 16 to 200 characters, or json: a dotted path, an equals sign, and a JSON string, boolean, or number.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen id. One value for one agent_key refers to one receipt.

agent_key.description: Pseudonymous key for this log. Not a credential.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Reads one stored receipt and GETs its public target_url. The verdict is verified, not_found, mismatch, or unverifiable, with source, as_of, ttl, version, and label tested or unknown. verified requires a full-body sha256, an exact text/plain body of 16 to 200 characters, or an exact JSON scalar at a dotted path. HTTP 404 and 410 are not_found. A finished comparison that fails is mismatch. Private, loopback, link-local, and metadata addresses, including after DNS and redirects, plus timeouts, oversized bodies, and any other uncertainty, are unverifiable.

tools.name: get_receipts
tools.description: Returns the receipt log stored for one pseudonymous agent_key. Each receipt includes its chain hash and the fields source, as_of, ttl, version, and label. The log is keyed only by that agent_key. No network address is included.

agent_key.description: Pseudonymous key whose log is returned.
